title: Lesson 06: Golden Hour
sources: Golden hour: the period shortly after sunrise and before sunset when the sun is low and light is warmer and softer (standard photography guidance)

lines.text: Why do some photos just glow?
It's the first hour after sunrise, and the last hour before sunset,
lines.caps: FIRST HOUR AFTER *SUNRISE | LAST HOUR BEFORE *SUNSET

lines.text: when the sun sits low, and the light turns soft and warm.
Harsh midday sun gives hard shadows and squinting faces.
Try putting the sun behind your subject,
for a glowing rim of light,
or tap the sky and slide the sun down, for a silhouette.
